howto: Pick Trials (18 goals with stars), Classic (Easy 5x5, Normal 4x4 or Hard 3x3) or the Daily board.
Swipe anywhere on the screen, or press an arrow key, to slide every tile.
Two tiles with the same number merge into one: 2 + 2 makes 4. Each new tile value introduces a new critter friend.
Build a 2048 tile (512 on the 3x3 board), or hit the goal of the trial, before the board fills up.
tips: Keep your biggest tile in one corner and build towards it.
Try not to swipe away from your corner: a stray 2 can get stuck there.
Hint looks two moves ahead and shows the swipe that keeps the most space free.
Undo takes back a move (5 per Classic game, 3 per trial or daily board).
Every 12 merges earns a hammer that smashes one tile.

controls.keyboard: Arrow keys or WASD slide the tiles, Z or U undoes, H hints. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Swipe anywhere. Undo, Hint, Hammer and Menu sit under the board.

difficulty: Board size is the difficulty in Classic: Easy is 5x5, Normal is 4x4, Hard is 3x3 with a 512 goal. Trials rise from roomy 5x5 boards to crowded 4x4 and 3x3 starts, each with a move limit.

cheats.effect: Hammer time: three hammers, ready to smash
All fours: every new tile is a 4
Big tile: a 256 drops into an empty square

features.hints: Hint button (H key, Pause > Hint): a two-move look-ahead shows an arrow for the swipe that keeps the most space free and says why
features.undo: Undo button (Z key): 5 per Classic game, 3 per trial or daily board; takes back the move and the tile it spawned
features.level-select-or-daily: Trials: 3 worlds x 6 goals (reach a tile, a score or a merge count within a move limit) with 3 stars each; plus a Daily board that gives everyone the same tiles today
features.results: A result card with score, best tile, merges, moves and XP earned; trials show the stars; a big-tile card introduces each new critter
features.tutorial: First game: a guided board where you swipe, merge two 2s and learn undo and hint; skippable, replayed from How to play
features.progression: 18 trials x 3 stars (worlds open at 10 and 26 stars); XP levels unlock 6 tile looks (wood, critter faces, marble, night glass, ocean pearl, gold); a 12-critter album filled by reaching each tile; 3 daily goals and a weekly stamp chest
